definition: Reason distinguishes an intrinsic token from a circumstance token, and Model.explains stipulates which reason tokens explain which world-relative existence facts. Sound only requires that the explained fact be true. A token is neither an external efficient cause, nor a proof that an essence really explains instantiation, nor an independent justification of explanatory sufficiency.
note: Analyst-assigned explanation candidates for the finite countermodels in #312; philosophical admissibility of such reasons and the difference between explanatory relations and causes remain separate open questions.
